description: List the tenant's sending pool — every mailbox acting as a sending source, with its warm-up state, daily cap and pacing. Read this before queueing a broadcast: capacity and warm-up state are what decide whether an audience drains in a day or a month. A mailbox registered for reading mail is not automatically a sending source.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_list_sources
